title: Script30 DB Patterns guiding principle
description: Org-level guiding principle for database patterns: connection pool eviction, migration versioning, savepoint management, query planning, replication monitoring, and schema validation.
code:
# Database Patterns — Org Guiding Principle

## Connection Pool Eviction
- Evict LRU (oldest last_used_at), never FIFO.
- Emit orgops.metrics.emit("pool.connection.evicted", idle_seconds) on eviction.

## Migration Versioning
- Compare versions numerically (int), never lexicographically (string).
- Write orgops.auditing.write_event("migration.applied", version=v) for each migration.

## Savepoint Management
- After ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT, always RELEASE SAVEPOINT to free resources.
- Annotate via orgops.tracing.annotate_span("txn.savepoint.rolled_back", id).

## Query Cost Estimation
- Apply selectivity exactly once per join, never double-count.
- Emit orgops.metrics.emit("query.plan.estimated_cost", cost) for planner telemetry.

## Replication Monitoring
- Compare lag and threshold in the same units (both ms or both seconds).
- Alert via orgops.alerts.notify("replication.lag.exceeded", lag_ms=v) when threshold breached.

## Schema Validation
- Column type comparisons must be case-insensitive.
- Record orgops.compliance.record_decision("schema.validation.passed", column_type=t).
